entity: US federal place names (GNIS) that still contain 'Negro'
what_we_add: The 438 split (426 current, 12 historical); 105 listing the n-word as an older name; the side-by-side of 641 'Squaw' renamings vs at least 41 'Negro' or n-word ones in 2020-23
why: Atmos (2022) counts 469 GNIS names still carrying 'Negro', 7% off our 438, same direction; CRS and Interior put the Squaw renamings at about 650-657, within 3% of 641. No source sets the two renaming counts side by side or counts the n-word older names; Vocativ's 558 (2015) is a broader definition and doesn't conflict.
